<quote by="Announced by Lula Kleist von Ennerlund, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">To commission a sinecure, the BAKERS' BOWL, a stadium in Holmauer, Holberg as part of the newly formed Casinean League. Sinecure to create the position SPONSOR OF THE HOLBERG HAMMERS, a lifetime League National position, to be appointed by League Senators. REVOCABLE by the Assembly of Nine, General Assembly and League National Assembly. POWERS: receives an income of at least 216 rings per season. RESPONSIBILITIES: Responsible for the well-being of the staduim and the team. SELF-FUNDED with 20 wains weirwood and coin, by Lula and Bernhard Kleist von Ennerlund. We invite Calcio and Foot-the-Ball teams for other cities and towns unfortunate enough not to yet have their own stadiums to use the Bakers' Bowl for train and to play fixtures.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Holmauer, Holberg
* Announcement by '''Lula Kleist von Ennerlund''', [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 20 wains of weirwood
* 60 crowns in labour costs 
* Three months to construct
